question_text: A function receives a string parameter text and executes text="Updated". Describe why the caller’s name variable is unchanged, and how the caller can receive the new string.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: The assignment rebinds the function’s local parameter rather than the caller’s variable. Return the new string and assign it in the caller, for example name=update(name).

marking_points.criterion: Local rebinding does not change caller binding.
